name: Strong Pro
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For Strong Pro, log workouts, templates, sets, rest timers, and personal history locally. The hard boundary is mobile polish, widgets, watch app, cloud sync, and exercise database, plus hardware data, content, coaching, and trust.
